ledger.why: who competes: the trials name no villager (no game skill matches these contestants)
a small ('modest') game-scaled food reward on the constructive outcomes (A1, B1, B3); reputation is told only (rule 7)

intro.name: The trial
intro.text: The village challenges singers to perform the notoriously long Sixteenth Aria composed by (Composer). It contains unexpected turns, difficult intervals, and verses few can remember.

choices.label: Allow interpretation, but require the entire aria.

text_only.reason: only a living villager can be named; the composer also acts in the outcomes

a1.text: An unassuming singer performs every verse perfectly. The composer weeps with pride.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

a2.text: The composer forgets the ninth verse while correcting a contestant. The audience erupts in laughter.

a3.text: A contestant reaches the final note, only to discover the judges disagree on whether an old refrain counts as a verse.

b1.text: A bold singer transforms the aria into a moving lament. The composer initially protests, then embraces the performer.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

b2.text: A disastrous rendition becomes a wildly popular children's song, much to the composer's horror.

b3.text: Two singers finish together after one quietly helps the other remember a missing line. The judges award a shared victory.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.

p2.text: An accusation of favoritism forces the judges to disclose their criteria; the disputed result is upheld, reversed, or declared a tie.

p3.text: Competitors from both communities secretly practice together and publicly acknowledge each other when the results are announced.
